programs.title: The Reserve
programs.desc: The Reserve centres on the desperate fight to protect the rhino, one of Africa's most iconic species. In 2018, Balule was on its knees due to rhino poaching, losing over 65 animals, including 17 in one year alone.

programs.title: World Endurance Championship - Highlights
programs.desc: The FIA World Endurance Championship is the world's premier international sportscar championship. Highlights from all eight rounds across North America, Europe, Asia and the Middle East.

programs.title: Premier League
programs.desc: Chelsea trail the European places after six consecutive league defeats, while Liverpool sits in the Champions League spots; the Blues claimed victories over the Reds in their last two meetings, winning the most recent matchup on Oct. 4, 2-1.

programs.title: Snackmasters
programs.sub_title: Allen's Lollies: Red Snakes, Green Snakes, Sherbies & Bananas
programs.desc: Join hosts Scott Pickett and Poh Ling Yeow as two elite chefs battle to make perfect replicas of one of the nation's best-loved snacks, while inveterate snack lover Yvie Jones gains access to the production lines for these delicious treats, giving viewers a sneak peek inside the factories where the snacks are made.

programs.title: Wonder
programs.desc: A 10-year-old boy with facial disfigurements that have so far required almost 30 operations takes on a whole new challenge when, after being home educated his entire life, enters mainstream school for the first time. As he struggles to fit in, his fellow pupils and the community are forced to learn the power of compassion and acceptance. Julia Roberts, Owen Wilson and Jacob Tremblay star in Stephen Chbosky's drama, based on the best-selling novel by RJ Palacio.

programs.title: The Addams Family 2
programs.desc: The Addams get tangled up in more wacky adventures and find themselves involved in hilarious run-ins with all sorts of unsuspecting characters. Sequel to the 2019 animated film, 'The Addams Family'.
